criteria.evidence: TailoringViewModelTest.progressRowsAtQuartersAndNeverFullBeforeResult asserts 0/25/50/75/99 and row states, no 100 before result; baselines tailoring 0/50/100 + font2 read, match prototype layout. 4000ms/40ms delay() ramp in the VM is state timing, not an animation (no tween/spring/duration in feature code, grep clean); acceptable. Ticking counter does not consult motion.reduced but nothing visual is tweened.
TailoringViewModelTest.successReplacesWithTailored asserts Done outcome and progress 100 (runner side is Reviewer B scope).
TailoringViewModelTest.failureEmitsFailedOutcome asserts Failed and progress <100; failed baseline read.
TailoredPaperMapperTest covers highlights with/without answer, summary-first, skills-last, rejected bullet unhighlighted, span concatenation invariant; copy is '% keywords' (D5, no match/fit/ATS).

Cards only for changed text and violating bullets are reverted by the use case, so none appear. But ChangeCardMapperTest.prototypeAnswerGivesThreeChangesAndNoInfosysAdded builds its own resume, so it cannot fail if the employer rule is removed; the I.1 rule is enforced only in TailorResumeUseCase.

Per-change Undo incl. summary and skills tested in TailorViewModelDecisionTest and ChangeCardMapperTest.undoneChangeShowsOriginal..., but an undone Added card renders an empty body (finding 1) and is untested.
TailorViewModelDecisionTest.acceptChangesAcceptsEveryPendingAndStampsChangesAcceptedAt; single Accept changes button in footer; accepted baseline read.
exportRefused... and exportAllowedAfterAccept tests; export-disabled baseline present; Export uses enabled=exportEnabled with onDisabledClick toast.
TailoredNoPerBulletTogglesTest; TailoredScreen has only per-change Undo, no per-bullet toggles.
font2_337dp baselines read: Changes tab label and Export PDF wrap at word boundaries, nothing ellipsized or clipped; hero scales height with fontScale.
CI Build jobs were still IN_PROGRESS at review time; delivery-gates-pregate and Detect code changes passed.

findings.trigger: An Added bullet (originalText blank, kind Added) with decision REJECTED yields after = originalText = "" and before = null, so the card after Undo shows tag and chips, an empty body and 'Undone'; the user cannot see what was undone.
findings.title: Undone Added card renders an empty body
findings.proof: ChangeCardMapperTest: bullet original="" proposed="X" decision=REJECTED; assert cards[0].after is not blank (fails today).

findings.trigger: Test hand-builds a resume with no Infosys Added card, so deleting the employer-names rule from TailorResumeUseCase leaves it green; the mapper itself has no I.1 check.
findings.title: No-Infosys-Added assertion is vacuous in the mapper test
